main_text.l: dum, etiam de iis, quæ ne quidem vulgus
inter didactica tradere non duxi consul-
Metaphysicas, si Deo ita visum, brevi ,
vindicem. Hæ si tibi gratæ videantur,
unâ precare mecum Ἀρχιφιλόσοφον, ut conatus
meos alina sua benedictione largiter velit

page.notes: The marginal dot before "adornabo" is a reference mark, not a word. The Greek word is printed as Ἀρχιφιλόσοφον (approximate reading). The word "alinā" is read as "alina" with a superscript mark, doubtful. Faint stains and a small mark near the bottom centre are not printed text.
